## Plugin / 插件

Link to the plugin page and describe what changed. / 链接插件说明页，说明本次变更。

## Review / 审核

- [ ] English and Chinese explain how to use this plugin. / 中英文说明都介绍了插件的实际用法。
- [ ] The source link points to the reviewed commit, the license matches it and the author provides the listed download. / 源码链接、适用许可证和作者下载地址对应所列版本。
- [ ] I regenerated the directory and ran `python3 scripts/catalog.py --check`. / 已生成目录并核对生成结果。

If supplying direct-install data or verification, record the downloaded artifact digest, observed manifest ID or verification steps as applicable. / 如果提供直接安装资料或核验记录，请附相应的文件摘要、实际清单 ID 或核验步骤。
